subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should this five-PR durable-core stack land on the 2026.7.1 release line, be retargeted to main or the next release, or remain unlanded?
rationale: The PR introduces a broad opt-in runtime, persisted schema, public inspection surfaces, and session-recovery semantics; code review cannot choose the supported release and rollout contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Retarget and land after proof
options.body: Retarget the dependency-ordered stack to main or the next supported release and require exact-head generation-fence and upgrade proof before landing.

options.title: Backport to 2026.7.1
options.body: Explicitly sponsor this as a 2026.7.1 backport and require the full ordered stack plus release-line validation before merge.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Keep the PRs open or close them if the durable-runtime product direction is not currently sponsored.

recommendation.title: Retarget and land after proof
recommendation.body: Retarget the dependency-ordered stack to main or the next supported release and require exact-head generation-fence and upgrade proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available owner trail for the existing restart-continuation queue boundary that the stack extends.
